note: Step 4.8. Policy numbers shown to the reviewer for each target. Rule texts are NOT repeated here: review_inputs.py takes them from prompts.RULE_TEXT, so the reviewer and the generator use the same wording. Only C05 differs from the baseline (ComplyFixture.sol: cap 1000, country 408; Cfg05: cap 500, countries 408 and 643).
definitions: A wallet is KYC-verified when it is registered and holds a valid claim for EVERY required claim topic, signed by at least one issuer that is trusted for that topic.
Country codes are ISO 3166-1 numeric codes.
The cap counts the tokens of one investor identity, across all wallets of that identity.
